title: Echinacoside: A potential therapeutic approach for alcohol-related liver disease by alleviating intestinal microbial dysbiosis, intestinal barrier dysfunction, and liver inflammation mediated by the endotoxin-TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Wang, Haichao; Bian, Yifei; Li, Yaying; Yuan, Yuhao; Li, Xiaoyan; Liu, Yuhong; Wang, Xiaoming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究松果菊苷通过肠道菌群和TLR4/NF-kB通路缓解酒精性肝病，仅含分子对接评估小分子与TLR4结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) is one of the causes of chronic liver disease and a public health burden worldwide. Modulating the gut microbiota-hepatic immune loop is a key strategies for alleviate ALD. Echinacoside (ECH) is a natural phenylethanoidglycoside-structural compound that exerts significant anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, gut protective, and liver protective activities. However, as the therapeutic effect and mechanism of ECH in treating ALD remain unknown, this research aimed to investigate the impact of ECH on ALD and its potential mechanism. The intestinal damage, liver damage, and lipid accumulation in ALD mice were assessed by histological staining of tissue sections. The index of intestinal tight junction protein expression and the gut microbiota compositions were detected using molecular biology techniques and 16S rRNA sequencing analysis. The liver inflammation and oxidative stress levels were determined using enzyme assay indicators. Western blot analysis was used to measure the expression of proteins linked to the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) signalling pathway. The potential mechanism of TLR4 inhibition was studied further. The binding affinity of ECH with TLR4 was evaluated by molecular docking and analysing drug affinity reaction target stability. ECH treatment effectively improved the intestinal permeability and dysbiosis of ALD mice, improved liver oxidative stress injury and lipid accumulation, and mediated TLR4 regulation of liver inflammatory response. Overall, this study emphasizes the potential role of ECH in maintaining intestinal permeability, dysbiosis, and treating liver damage.
abstract_zh: 酒精相关性肝病（ALD）是慢性肝病的病因之一，也是全球公共卫生负担。调节肠道微生物群-肝脏免疫回路是缓解ALD的关键策略之一。松果菊苷（ECH）是一种天然苯乙醇苷类结构化合物，具有显著的抗炎、抗氧化、肠道保护和肝脏保护活性。然而，由于ECH治疗ALD的治疗效果和机制尚不清楚，本研究旨在探讨ECH对ALD的影响及其潜在机制。通过组织切片的组织学染色评估ALD小鼠的肠道损伤、肝脏损伤和脂质积累。利用分子生物学技术和16S rRNA测序分析检测肠道紧密连接蛋白表达指数和肠道微生物群组成。使用酶学检测指标测定肝脏炎症和氧化应激水平。采用Western blot分析测量与Toll样受体4（TLR4）/核因子-κB（NF-κB）信号通路相关蛋白的表达。进一步研究了TLR4抑制的潜在机制。通过分子对接和分析药物亲和力反应靶点稳定性评估ECH与TLR4的结合亲和力。ECH治疗有效改善了ALD小鼠的肠道通透性和菌群失调，改善了肝脏氧化应激损伤和脂质积累，并介导了TLR4对肝脏炎症反应的调控。总体而言，本研究强调了ECH在维持肠道通透性、菌群失调及治疗肝脏损伤方面的潜在作用。
